name: drone-commander-call
title: A commander drone and its call actor
shows: The commander's drone in the air beside the CALL actor that spawned it. The call actor's root position reads (0, 0, z) and means nothing, and its life outruns the pawn's — so nothing is drawn for it at the map origin, and the drone the viewer draws is the pawn. The pawn's class declares no battery, so its budget is the calling action's 420 s active window.
rule: §9 Drones (the call actor draws nothing, the commander drone's budget); §6 the call actor's (0, 0, z)
